instruction: Geo-located KMZ Export (Placemark Model) The file `C:\Users\user\Desktop\house.dae` contains a non-trivial architectural building model: a single-storey house with four separate geometries - outer walls (with a door opening cut into the front wall), a pitched gable roof, a door panel, and a floor slab. All dimensions are in meters with the footprint covering X in [0, 10], Y in [0, 6], Z in [-0.1, 5]. wrap `C:\Users\user\Desktop\house.dae` inside a geo-located Google Earth KMZ placemark. Produce a single output `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.kmz` - a ZIP archive containing two members with the exact names shown below: doc.kml - OGC KML 2.2 document models/house.dae - a copy of the input DAE, referenced by the KML The KML document must contain a `<Placemark>` whose child is a `<Model>` element (not a bare `<Point>`) that places the house at San Francisco: - `<Location><longitude>-122.4194</longitude><latitude>37.7749</latitude><altitude>0</altitude></Location>` - `<Orientation>` with `<heading>`, `<tilt>` and `<roll>` elements (use 0 for each - true-north alignment on a flat reference surface) - `<altitudeMode>relativeToGround</altitudeMode>` (any KML-recognized altitudeMode is accepted) - `<Scale>` with x/y/z = 1 - `<Link><href>models/house.dae</href></Link>` - the Link/href must match the ZIP entry name for the bundled DAE exactly. The KML root element must be `<kml xmlns="http://www.opengis.net/kml/2.2">`. Wrap the Placemark in a `<Document>` inside the root. Reference: OGC KML 2.2 specification, `<Model>` element (Location/Orientation/Scale/Link children). Requirements: 1. `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.kmz` exists and is a valid ZIP (no corrupt members). 2. The ZIP contains both `doc.kml` and `models/house.dae` with those exact names. 3. `doc.kml` parses as well-formed XML with the `http://www.opengis.net/kml/2.2` namespace on the root `<kml>`. 4. A `<Placemark>` is present and contains a `<Model>` element. 5. The Model's `<Location><longitude>` equals -122.4194 within 1e-6 and `<latitude>` equals 37.7749 within 1e-6. 6. The Model has an `<Orientation>` block with heading, tilt and roll numeric children. 7. The Model declares a valid KML `<altitudeMode>` (one of: relativeToGround, absolute, clampToGround, relativeToSeaFloor, clampToSeaFloor). 8. The Model's `<Link><href>` exactly names `models/house.dae` and that path is an entry in the KMZ. 9. The DAE extracted from the KMZ parses via `pycollada` and contains at least 3 separate geometries (non-trivial house, not a single cuboid). 10. The extracted DAE has at least one triangle in its geometries. [Software] Launch SketchUp with `C:\SketchUp 2026 26.0.429 x64 En Portable\SketchUp.exe` (adjust if your install differs).
